news.lead: Each step, on the day it happened.
news.seoDescription: Each step of the work told on the day it happened, with its date and its photos. What was bought, what was done, and what is still missing.

home.openingLead: A fire took a great deal from us, but not the most important thing: the strength of a community that stays.
home.fireLead: On Monday 7 September, at 4.30 in the morning, a fire destroyed the family home in Riacho He Hé. Norma died. Her husband survived and is in treatment.
home.houseNote: This is what was left of our house.
home.communityLead: Family, neighbours and friends. In the same days as the fire, the community organised to clear and haul debris.
home.seeWork: See the work on the house
home.pathHandsLead: If you can go, Justo coordinates. WhatsApp, and the map of the town.
home.pathMoneyLead: Bank transfer from Argentina or Chile, Mercado Pago or PayPal.
home.pathArticlesLead: The list of what is still needed, so two people don't bring the same thing.
home.donateLead: Bank transfer from Argentina or Chile, Mercado Pago or PayPal. Choose where you are giving from and copy the details.
home.mercadoPagoLead: There is a Mercado Pago link for Argentina and another for Chile. Choose the one for your country.
home.paypalLead: Make your contribution securely from any country.
home.thanksNote: Thank you for being part of this.
home.normaLead: She spent much of her life recording the everyday history of Riacho He Hé.
home.nextLead: First we want to rebuild a house. Then we want to help build opportunities for Riacho He Hé through communication and digital tools.
home.nextBody: Once the family has a place to live, the intention is that this continues: communication and digital tools for other people in the town. It is not an organisation yet. The site says so.
home.nextNote: The same community that is helping today can create more opportunities.

completed.title: Thank you
completed.lead: If the PayPal contribution went through, it reaches the family.
completed.seoDescription: Thank you for contributing to rebuilding the family house of Norma, in Riacho He Hé.
paragraphs: Thank you. The house is being rebuilt with contributions like this: there is no organization in the middle, and the site does not charge.
You do not need to write to us. PayPal notifies on its side. This page is not a receipt: it is only where PayPal sent you when the payment finished.
What comes into the accounts is published on Transparency when the figures have been reconciled, not at the moment of payment. If you want to follow the work, that is in Updates.
If you would rather write, the published contact is on Contact.

cancelled.title: The contribution was not completed
cancelled.lead: Thank you for getting this far.
cancelled.seoDescription: The PayPal contribution was not completed. If you still want to help rebuild the house, you can try again.
paragraphs: PayPal sent us back to this page because the payment was not finished. Thank you anyway for getting this far.
If it was an accidental close, or a detail that did not go through, you can try again. It would help a great deal: the priority is rebuilding the family house in Riacho He Hé.

The channels are on Donate money: a transfer from Argentina or Chile, Mercado Pago, and PayPal. Use whichever is at hand. The site does not ask for card details or process the payment: it takes you to the channel and nothing more.
If you would rather not use PayPal, a bank transfer arrives in full. The verified details are on that same page.
